title: Report for Jun 18, 2026

methodology.note: Current month (Jun 2026) is projected as month-to-date actual ($8,269.01) plus the trailing 14-day run rate ($437.45/day) over the 12 day(s) left in the month. Future months (through Sep 2026) are projected at the average daily run rate over the trailing 45 days ($420.82/day) applied to each month's day count, so the forecast tracks the recent run rate rather than an assumed monthly escalation. Projections are recomputed fresh from actuals each week.

analysis: Note: starting with this report, figures reflect actual metered token consumption pulled directly from Anthropic's Enterprise Analytics API, replacing the earlier estimate based on credit-card top-ups. Totals therefore differ from prior weeks — actual usage runs a few percent below the prepaid top-ups, and the numbers are now true daily consumption rather than lumpy prepayment charges. Anthropic token spend totals $30,990 across 118 days of metered usage from Feb 20, 2026 through Jun 17, 2026. Spend is running near $421/day (about $12,625/month) and is trending up about 11% versus May 2026. Jun 2026 is projected to finish around $13,518 ($8,269 booked to date), with the trailing 45-day run rate putting $13,045 in Jul 2026, $13,045 in Aug 2026, $12,625 in Sep 2026. Cumulative spend through Sep 2026 is projected at roughly $74,955.
